portal_description:
The rh-maven35 Software Collection provides Maven, a software project management and comprehension tool. Based on the concept of a project object model (POM), Maven can manage a project's build, reporting, and documentation from a central place.

This enhancement update adds the rh-maven35 packages to Red Hat Software Collections. (BZ#1448496)

For details, see the Red Hat Software Collections 3.0 Release Notes linked from the References section.

All users who require rh-maven35 are advised to install these new packages.
